description: This file defines a class for the Legacy module in the HTML Purifier library, which adds support for deprecated HTML elements and attributes as part of HTML sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Legacy
classes.description: A module extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule that defines support for deprecated HTML elements such as 'font', 'center', 's', 'strike', etc., and modifies their attributes and content models for legacy support.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the Legacy module by adding deprecated and legacy HTML elements with their respective attributes, content models, and formatting rules.
